strengths.I008: Zero extra tokens at equal budget; corrects measurable position and self-preference bias and reweights judges by fit to external verdicts, with a clean offline test (held-out-brief agreement and Kendall tau, uniform vs judge-aware BT) against an external reference.
strengths.I002: Cross-run memory of which typed edit operators win, chosen by similarity-weighted Thompson sampling, is a novel use of the idea library and is nearly free in tokens; child-beats-parent rate is a countable outcome.

verdicts.reason: I008 directly improves the final selection using external verdicts and bias correction, and it is testable offline. I002 depends on an unbuilt contest loop, needs hundreds of contests to detect small effects, and its win/loss labels come from the in-loop judge, so it may learn that judge's quirks rather than quality.

strengths.I003: Chooses the top 3 to maximise the expected best idea, using correlated mechanism clusters, which matches what a user needs (one good idea) and counters a single agent's habit of picking three variants of its favourite theme; it is about 60 lines of NumPy and can be replayed offline on saved data.
strengths.I008: Judge-reliability weighting with bias terms (position, self-preference) and a boundary-focused comparison budget improves the accuracy of the ranking at no extra token cost.

verdicts.reason: I003 is a single switch that can be replayed on saved pairwise records and panel ratings and scored on best-of-3, mean-of-3 and cluster count. I008 needs about 300 past votes and stable judge reliability before it can be fitted, and its gain over uniform weighting is likely small.

strengths.I005: Replaces critique prose with claims that sandbox scripts or library lookups can falsify, so survival depends on checks passed and not on persuasive writing. This adds an external signal a lone agent lacks, and the falsified-claim rate is a measured outcome.
strengths.I007: A residual logistic head with nuisance covariates (length, hedging, family match) is anchored to the current BT weight, so it reduces to today's ranking when labels are few. Its offline test is cheap.

verdicts.reason: I005 adds grounded verification at the critique and selection stages, which a single self-selecting agent cannot do, and it withholds the prose that biases judges. I007 needs at least 15 labelled briefs, risks learning the panel's biases, and is unlikely to move the top 3 much from about 10 labels per brief.

strengths.I001: Puts critique and single-edit mutation effort where the top-3 cutoff is uncertain, with acceptance rules against parent and incumbent and a length cap, so it improves the ideas themselves (development) and not just their selection. The test is on/off at equal tokens against uniform development, with child-beats-parent measured under a held-out judge family.
strengths.I003: A cheap, well-specified portfolio selection rule that maximises the expected best of 3 with cluster-correlated uncertainty; testable offline. Its gain depends on the finalists being redundant.

verdicts.reason: I001 can raise the quality of the ideas through targeted refinement guided by an independent judge, a larger potential gain than I003, which only reshuffles a fixed finalist pool and can lose on mean rating or have no effect if the finalists are already diverse.
